payload.title: ServerOptions.projections: app projection registration
payload.description: Add ServerOptions.projections?: readonly FrickProjection[] and register each into the store's projection registry at boot (alongside server.ts:415/:581). Today the registry is created empty and no app can populate it. Keep HTTP read (GET /projections/:name) working. Validate projection.sources reference real object/stream types in the active schema. Unit test: a registered projection's apply() runs on a matching object upsert and its read()/rows reflect the change.
